name: Geek'd Extracts - 24K Gold Series - Trainwreck - 4g THCA Disposable - Sativa
description:
Blast off with Trainwreck from Geek'd's 24K Gold Series. This powerful 4-gram sativa disposable features THCA liquid diamonds, THCP, and Hydroxy-11 for intense cerebral energy and creative focus. Lemon, pine, and earthy flavors deliver classic sativa effects perfect for productivity and socializing. USB-C rechargeable, preheat-enabled, and Farm Bill compliant. Long-lasting battery with sleek, discreet design. Premium hemp-derived cannabinoids for all-day potency and flavor.

Details

• Trainwreck (Sativa)

• 4 Gram Disposable

• 24K Gold Series Live Resin Blend

How to Use

• 5 clicks - ON/OFF

• 2 Clicks - preheat

• Connect device to USB-C cord for charging. Activate device and inhale.

• USB-C cord not included.

Cannabinoids

• THCA

• THCP

• Hydroxy-11

• Delta-8

What is THCA?

THCA is the natural precursor to THC that delivers the classic "high" when heated.

This enigmatic cannabinoid holds immense potential, offering a multitude of therapeutic benefits. THCA, the precursor to THC, is a cannabinoid found in the hemp plant that converts to Delta-9 when decarboxylated (heated). When combined with other cannabinoids, such as Delta-8, the results will leave you feeling a sense of calm.

What is THCP?

THCP Unforgettable High

Experience an unforgettable high with THCP, the most potent THC cannabinoid. THCP offers immediate and highly psychoactive effects that are approximately 33x as strong as Delta-9.

What is Hydroxy-11?

11-Hydroxy-THC is a Potent Isolated Cannabinoid

The 11-Hydroxy-THC cannabinoid is the result of your body digesting and processing THC. When you ingest THC, your body converts the Delta 8 or Delta 9 edibles into 11-Hydroxy-THC. However, we've isolated that naturally occurring cannabinoid and made it possible to enjoy it without waiting for your body to process it. The result is a powerful cannabinoid that is extremely potent and can be processed by your body a lot more efficiently.

What is Delta-8?

Delta-8 Is Made From Pure CBD

THC8 (Delta-8) the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. THC8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

Full Panel COA

Trainwreck

THCA Disclaimer

This product is not available for shipment to the following states: Hawaii, Idaho, Minnesota, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, and Vermont.
